correctness.rationale: The source specifies 20 labelled bits in row-major order on Z/4 x Z/5, eight distinct Moore neighbours, B3/S23 synchronous update, and first-entry depth to a functional-graph cycle. Both complete C++ programs construct all 2^20 transitions (one via bit masks and forward chains, the other via coordinate loops plus indegree stripping); cycle and reverse-pruning logic classifies each state exactly once and the 80 spatial affine sign/translation maps commute with the update. I separately compiled and ran an independently written C++ exhaustive indegree-pruning enumerator and separate symmetry-action enumeration. It gave 461 orbits with primitive periods 1:313, 2:32, 4:20, 5:8, 6:60, 8:20, 10:8; exactly 1,097 recurrent configurations, sharp depth 21 realized by 80 states, 23 geometric classes, an empty fixed-state basin of 884,500, and period-5 basin 40 versus period-10 basin 9,340. Period/basin totals independently sum to 1,048,576. Exhaustiveness is for precisely this finite 4x5 torus, not arbitrary boards.

These precise structural distinctions are neither routine consequences of Life’s update rule nor mere recomputation of its known fixed-point count.
